name: aeliqo-v0-1-0-master-foundation
description: Aeliqo rewrite specification and delivery harness; not a published UI runtime

scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:runtime && pnpm build:platform && tsc --project tsconfig.json
scripts.build:platform: pnpm build:core && pnpm --filter @aeliqo/web build && pnpm --filter @aeliqo/react build
scripts.test:next-platform: pnpm build:core && pnpm --filter @aeliqo/web build && pnpm --filter @aeliqo/next-platform-fixture build && playwright test --config tests/next-platform/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.test:contracts: pnpm build:core && vitest run --config tests/contracts/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/contracts/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:task-experience: pnpm build:core && vitest run --config tests/task-experience/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/task-experience/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:query: pnpm build:core && vitest run --config tests/query/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/query/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:data: pnpm build:runtime && vitest run --config tests/runtime-data/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/runtime-data/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:results: pnpm build:runtime && vitest run --config tests/runtime-results/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/runtime-results/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:regions: pnpm build:runtime && vitest run --config tests/runtime-regions/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/runtime-regions/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:actions: pnpm build:runtime && vitest run --config tests/runtime-actions/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/runtime-actions/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:interaction: pnpm build:runtime && vitest run --config tests/runtime-interaction/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/runtime-interaction/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:evaluation: pnpm build:runtime && vitest run --config tests/runtime-evaluation/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/runtime-evaluation/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:vertical: pnpm build:runtime && pnpm build:platform && vitest run --config tests/vertical-slice/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/vertical-slice/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:vertical:browser: pnpm build:runtime && pnpm build:platform && playwright test --config tests/vertical-slice/playwright.config.mjs && playwright test --config tests/vertical-slice/web/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.test:agents: pnpm build:agent && vitest run --config tests/agents/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/agents/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:foundation: pnpm build:platform && vitest run --config tests/foundation/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/foundation/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:plot: pnpm build:platform && vitest run --config tests/plot/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/plot/tsconfig.json && node tests/plot/ssr.mjs
